# aggregation function

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:aggregationFunction`](gmeow-aggregationFunction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/aggregationFunction>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/aggregation`](../../slices/aggregation.md)

The statistical function applied to the entities in the aggregation region — count, sum, average, density, minimum, maximum, or centroid.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SpatialAggregation`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialAggregation.md) -> [`gmeow:AggregationFunction`](../classes/gmeow-AggregationFunction.md); functional
